newsitem.title: DUBAI: Credit to Oman's industries up 36.6 pct in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Credit to Oman's industries up 36.6 pct in Q1.

text.p: Credit lines extended by Oman's 18 local and foreign banks to the industrial sector grew by 36.6 percent in the year to end-March, a central bank statement said on Friday.

"Credits to the manufacturing sector grew to 95.1 million rials ($35.8 million) by the end of the first quater of 1997 from 69.6 million rials in the same period of 1996," the statement carried by the official Oman News Agency said.
It said personal loans, put at 602.6 million rials, continued to top the commercial banks' credit portfolios accounting for 34.3 percent of total credits extended during the period.
Credits to importers was put at 14.8 percent and to financial institutions at 5.5 percent.
The bank, in an earlier statement said that credit extended to the commercial sector grew by 21.6 percent to 1.76 billion rials on March 31, 1997.
